title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, Mar 6, 2027
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs a concert built around Dvořák's New World Symphony, written after he came to the U.S. to lead the National Conservatory of Music in New York. The program also includes Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto with violinist Fiona Shea, and it showcases the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at the Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
